notes: Election: seven trustees are elected by the voters of the San Francisco Community College District (citywide) to staggered four-year terms in even-numbered years, as provided in the City Charter (BP 1.01, search summary); the board also has a non-voting student trustee (FY27 adopted budget document, search summary). On November 3, 2026 voters elect three trustees to four-year terms and one trustee to the remainder of an unexpired term (Voter Information Pamphlet, search summary). Term limits: none found either way in the sources searched; the Charter text (codelibrary.amlegal.com) could not be opened. Budget: not recorded; the FY27 tentative and adopted budget documents on ccsf.edu were seen only in search summaries that showed no total. Salary: $6,000 a year in a 2022 candidate-recruitment listing and $500 a month in 2012 news reports (search summaries); no current figure was found, and whether state stipend bills (AB 1390, AB 2528) changed CCSF trustee pay was not confirmed. CivLab (opened 2026-11-03) maps the board with 7 seats, links the San Francisco Charter as its legal source, and listed six named trustees plus an unnamed seat 7. CivLab's budget figure on this page ($16.85 billion) is the citywide total and is not used here. Hosts that could not be opened from this session: ccsf.edu, sf.gov, media.api.sf.gov, codelibrary.amlegal.com, www.census.gov, cbsnews.com, web.archive.org (so no archive snapshots).
